messages:
ashley-cs: Heads up — customer reported a sudden drop in generation quality + intermittent 503s after an auth-probe triggered a regional failover. Happening for EU users. Example request_id: req_7a9c.

ashley-cs: Sample input: `Invoice 8043: summarize charges` -> expected: a clean line-item summary. Actual: truncated text + odd token splits, extra <|unk|> tokens, and sometimes 503 body.

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] failover executed: route=eu-west -> standby-apac, reason=auth-probe-502, fallback_variant=small-quantized-v2, timestamp=2024-11-05T14:12:03Z

nina-support: Thanks. Can you paste the raw request/response (headers + minimal body) and the customer region? Also any correlation ids?

ashley-cs: Customer org: OrbitPay-EU. Correlation ids: req_7a9c / trace=trace-81b. Raw snippet: ```POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1
Content-Type: application/json
{"model":"gptx-2","input":"Summarize invoice 8043"}
```
Response (partial): ```{"error":{"code":503,"message":"service unavailable"}}``` or sometimes ```{"id":"resp_zz","model":"gptx-lite-v2-q4","output":"Summar y of charges: \u003c|unk|\u003e total \n"}```

raj-sre: Noted. Looks like the routing fallback swapped to `gptx-lite-v2-q4` (a reduced-capacity quantized variant) in standby-apac. That variant uses a different tokenizer (legacy-bpe-1.0) vs prod gptx-2 (bpe-1.3). Tokenizer mismatch explains the garbled <|unk|> tokens. Also the 503s correspond to auth refresh flapping while failover completed.

theo-runtime: Confirming — the runtime maps model_family -> fallback_variant in routing table. For capacity reasons we permit "downgrade_on_failover: true" for some regions. In this incident the policy applied during the auth-probe window and the customer got the downscoped binary.

nina-support: Customer impact: degraded outputs + some 503s -> they retried, which caused billing spikes. They want a root-cause and mitigation. Any quick mitigation we can give them?

raj-sre: Short term: 1) Recommend they set header `X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1` (we can honor regional pin if capacity present) 2) We can pin their org to model `gptx-2` via account config (manual override) 3) Disable `downgrade_on_failover` in routing for their org while we investigate.

marta-eng: Also escalate to oncall runtime for an immediate rollback of fallback policy in standby-apac. Ticketing: I'll open ENG-INC-4579 and tag runtime-oncall. Please include traces and the sample request/response. I'll pull billing meter for OrbitPay-EU to quantify retries.

theo-runtime: Repro steps I used locally to simulate (works in staging): ```# simulate auth probe and failover
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1" -d '{"model":"gptx-2","input":"test"}' https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# force failover by toggling routing: set /routing/regions/eu-west/active=false
# observe fallback serving variant and tokenizer header in response: X-Served-Model: gptx-lite-v2-q4; X-Tokenizer: legacy-bpe-1.0
```

raj-sre: Debug checklist for eng-oncall: - confirm fallback mapping file /config/fallbacks.json (look for gptx-2 -> gptx-lite-v2-q4) - verify model artifacts in standby-apac (tokenizer vocab id mismatch) - check auth-refresh logs 14:10-14:15Z for flapping - check autoscaler churn that might have forced downgrade.

nina-support: For the customer reply: proposed message: "We're sorry, we briefly routed your requests to a reduced-capacity standby model during an auth probe, which uses a different tokenizer. We're rolling back the fallback policy for your org and can pin requests to eu-west-1 while we investigate. We will credit retry charges after the RCA." Any edits? :thumbsup:

ashley-cs: That sounds good. Please add ETA: rollback within 30m, full RCA within 48h.

marta-eng: Oncall acknowledged. Rolling back `downgrade_on_failover` flag now for standby-apac and pushing a quick routing patch. I'll update ENG-INC-4579 with timeline.

raj-sre: Followup action items (short): [1] Push patch to prevent quantized lite variants as first fallback for model family gptx-2 across EU. [2] Add tokenizer compatibility check into pre-failover validation (compare vocab ids). [3] Support: generate credit for retries. [4] Product: consider explicit per-org fallback policy.

theo-runtime: Also adding a temporary guard: if request has header `X-Prevent-Variant-Downgrade: true` we will refuse fallback and return 429/maint instead of swapping to incompatible variant (configurable per-org).

ashley-cs: Customer notified and appreciates quick rollback. Will monitor. Thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] rollback applied: routing.fallbacks.standby-apac.gptx-2.downgrade_on_failover=false (applied by marta-eng), timestamp=2024-11-05T14:40:12Z

nina-support: Closing loop: please attach final RCA link here when ready and confirm credits applied.

marta-eng: Will post RCA to ENG-INC-4579 and confirm billing adjustments by EOD.
